'''Shernisa Varless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. A security commander on the [[Eternal Flagship]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]], she was onboard in [[3630 BBY]], when the Emperor received from [[SCORPIO]] the location of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] base of [[Odessen]] and took the flagship and a sizable portion of the [[Eternal Fleet]] there. In the ensuing [[Battle of Odessen]] the flagship was boarded by the Alliance forces. Varless encountered and engaged [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shernisa Varless appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 16: The Battle of Odessen'''.
